idea-plugin.name: License Flip Audit
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the dependencies whose licence changed under you - Terraform 1.6+ BUSL, Redis 7.4+ SSPL, Bitnami's August 2025 move, Elastic 7.11 - and names the exact version where each flip happened.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → License Flip Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 30 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/license-flip-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/license-flip-audit

action.text: License Flip Audit: Check This File
action.description: Run License Flip Audit on the file in the editor
